command.metrics.title: Show token metrics
config.statusBar.desc: Show live Claude plan usage (session · week) in the status bar.
config.statusBar.show5h: Show the 5-hour (session) usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.show7d: Show the 7-day (weekly) usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showContext: Show the session context usage gauge in the status bar.
config.statusBar.showSessions: Show how many Claude Code sessions and subagents are running, across every project.
config.alertWaiting: Show a notification when a Claude Code session starts waiting for your input.
config.metrics.days: How many days of transcripts the Metrics tab aggregates.
config.archive.days: Transcripts older than this many days are what "Archive old transcripts" moves aside.
config.statusBar.colorMode.desc: How the status-bar usage gauges are colored.
config.statusBar.colorMode.adaptive: Adapt to the theme — neutral when healthy, native warning/error highlight at high usage (always legible, even on a colored status bar).
config.statusBar.colorMode.usage: Fixed usage ramp — green → amber → red by how much you've used.
config.statusBar.colorMode.custom: A single fixed color you choose (set it in Custom Color).
config.statusBar.colorMode.none: No custom color — use the theme's default status-bar text color.
config.statusBar.customColor.desc: Color used when Color Mode is "custom" (e.g. #cccccc or #ccc). Leave empty to use the theme default.
config.statusBar.customColor.err: Use a hex color like #cccccc or #ccc, or leave empty.
config.planUsage.enabled: Read your plan usage. This is the extension's only network request and its only credential read — turn it off and everything else keeps working locally.
config.live.refreshSeconds: How often the Live tab re-reads running sessions. Lower is fresher; higher is cheaper with many parallel sessions.
config.quotaWarning.minutes: Warn once when the current burn rate projects your quota running out within this many minutes. 0 turns the warning off.
config.status.enabled: Watch Anthropic's public status page and warn when Claude Code or the API is degraded. An anonymous request to status.claude.com every five minutes — no token, nothing about you is sent. Turn it off and no request is ever made.
command.openStatusPage.title: Open the Claude status page
config.live.expandAgents: Whether a session's subagent tree starts open. Opening or closing one by hand always wins over this.
config.live.expandAgents.whileRunning: Open only while an agent is still working.
config.statusBar.alignment: Which side of the status bar the gauges sit on.
config.doctor.ignore: Health-check findings you have dismissed, by id.
